'''Alexandre Henri Joaquim Ruiz Campagne''' (born 3 September 1991) is a [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[goalkeeper (association football)|goalkeeper]] for {{ill|Club Esportiu Casa de Portugal|fr|lt=CE Casa de Portugal}}  of the Andorran [[Primera Divisió]]. Born in France, he made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2025.

==Club career==
Born in [[Pau, Pyrénées-Atlantiques|Pau]] in the [[Pyrénées-Atlantiques]] department of France, Ruiz was a youth player for [[Olympique Lyonnais]]. At 14, he moved to [[Real Sociedad]], having been [[Scout (sport)|scouted]] by [[Éric Olhats]], who had also taken 13-year-old [[Antoine Griezmann]] from [[UF Mâconnais]]; the teenage pair lived together until Griezmann made his first-team debut.<ref name=bondia>{{cite news |last1=Duaso |first1=Víctor |title=Amb Griezmann va començar tot|trans-title=It all started with Griezmann|url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/amb-griezmann-va-comencar-tot |access-date=9 April 2026 |work=[[Bondia (newspaper)|Bondia]] |date=4 September 2025 |language=Catalan}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=García |first1=Luisja |title=Alex Ruiz, de compartir piso con Griezmann a sensación en el Conquense|trans-title=Álex Ruiz, from sharing a flat with Griezmann to becoming a sensation for Conquense|url=https://cadenaser.com/emisora/2016/11/25/ser_cuenca/1480071642_910663.html |access-date=9 April 2026 |publisher=[[Cadena SER]] |date=25 November 2016 |language=Spanish}}</ref>

After a season-long loan to [[CD Elgoibar]],<ref>{{cite news |last1=Zabala |first1=Aitor |title=El CD Elgoibar confirma la llegada de seis nuevos jugadores|trans-title=CD Elgoibar confirm the arrival of six new players |url=https://www.diariovasco.com/v/20100710/bajo-deba/elgoibar-confirma-llegada-seis-20100710.html |access-date=9 April 2026 |work=[[El Diario Vasco]] |date=10 July 2010 |language=Spanish}}</ref> Ruiz left for [[Club Portugalete]], also in the [[Tercera División]]. In August 2012 he signed for another fourth-tier club, [[Burgos CF]],<ref>{{cite news |title=El club burgalés incorpora al portero Álex Ruiz|trans-title=Burgos's club brings in goalkeeper Álex Ruiz |url=https://www.diariodeburgos.es/noticia/zec97cfb4-feea-fd93-1e4464fa679f02b2/201208/el-club-burgales-incorpora-al-portero-alex-ruiz |access-date=9 April 2026 |work=[[Diario de Burgos]] |date=12 August 2012 |language=Spanish}}</ref> and at the end of January 2014, he transferred to [[CD Castellón]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Mena |first1=R. |title=Álex Ruiz deja el Burgos y ficha por el Castellón|trans-title=Álex Ruiz leaves Burgos and signs for Castellón |url=https://www.elcorreodeburgos.com/deportes/140131/115001/alex-ruiz-deja-burgos-ficha-castellon.html |access-date=9 April 2026 |work=El Correo de Burgos |date=31 January 2014 |language=Spanish}}</ref>

Ruiz remained in the same division for the following seasons, with [[CP Villarrobledo]], [[UB Conquense]] and [[Gimnástica de Torrelavega]], joining the latter for family reasons in October 2017.<ref>{{cite news |title=El portero Alex Ruiz ficha por la Gimnástica Torrelavega tras dejar el Conquense|trans-title=Goalkeeper Álex Ruiz signs for Gimnástica Torrelavega after leaving Conquense|url=https://www.lasnoticiasdecuenca.es/deportes/portero-alex-ruiz-ficha-gimnastica-torrelavega-dejar-conquense-30620 |access-date=9 April 2026 |work=Las Noticias de Cuenca |date=10 October 2017 |language=Spanish}}</ref> He won promotion to the [[Segunda División B]] in his first season in [[Cantabria]], and signed for [[CD Izarra]] in that league in June 2019.<ref>{{cite news |title=Fichaje internacional: el Izarra contrata a un portero francés para cubrir el hueco dejado por Julio Iricíbar|trans-title=International signing: Izarra sign a French goalkeeper to fill the gap left by Julio Iricíbar |url=https://navarra.okdiario.com/articulo/futbol/izarra-ficha-portero-frances/20190621192318270874.html |access-date=9 April 2026 |publisher=Navarra.com |date=21 June 2019 |language=Spanish}}</ref>

In 2020, Ruiz moved to Andorra, where he represented [[Atlètic Club d'Escaldes]], [[UE Sant Julià]], [[UE Santa Coloma]], [[FC Santa Coloma]] and {{ill|Club Esportiu Casa de Portugal|fr|lt=CE Casa de Portugal}} in the [[Primera Divisió]].<ref name=bondia/>

==International career==
Ruiz was naturalised as an [[Andorran nationality law|Andorran citizen]] by marrying a woman from that country.<ref name=bondia/> In September 2025, he was called up to the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] by manager [[Koldo Álvarez]], for a [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] [[2026 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)|qualifier]] away to [[England national football team|England]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Álvarez |first1=Ivan |title=El porter Álex Ruiz, la gran novetat de la llista|trans-title=Goalkeeper Álex Ruiz, big new name on the list |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/250905/porter-alex-ruiz-gran-novetat-llista_179588.html |access-date=9 April 2026 |work=[[Diari d'Andorra]] |date=5 September 2025 |language=Catalan}}</ref> His debut at age 34 was on 13 November in another qualifier, losing 1–0 at home to [[Albania national football team|Albania]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Basco |first1=Marc |title=Derrota mínima de la selecció (0-1)|trans-title=Narrowest defeat for the national team (0-1) |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/251113/derrota-minima-seleccio-0-1_183949.html |access-date=9 April 2026 |work=[[Diari d'Andorra]] |date=13 November 2025 |language=Catalan}}</ref>
